verdict.rationale: No documented account- or history-wide export feature exists. The evidence shows only indirect portability: headless runs can stream a session as JSON Lines, an open format (byteask-docs-5). Structured final output can conform to a JSON Schema (byteask-docs-6). Work stays in your own repository as diffs (byteask-docs-1), and bring-your-own OpenAI-compatible models reduce provider lock-in (byteask-docs-8). Missing for 10: a documented export of all account/session data, a way to export past sessions and history, account deletion/offboarding docs, and independent corroboration.
